observations: 用户要求的细节不能由简单几何草模证明；本轮以真实 Blender 建模和实际渲染为证据。
corrections: 修复拱形 Boolean 切割体法线，确保真实通道。
让薄玻璃透过阴影射线，保留窗框日光阴影。
将简单咖啡机换为精细单独建模的双头机器。
在真实舞台机位中将咖啡机和磨豆机移向右侧，保留人物头部后方留白。
Replace entire-room baked atlas with reusable per-object PBR textures to prevent dirty seams and lost source vertex colors.
Separate exterior privacy glazing from clear display-case glass.
Replace random exterior leaf cards and scattered boxes with coherent tree crowns and supported, aligned houses.
Replace independent post/beam positions that bisected apertures with a single solid-pier grid; verify actual evaluated posts against the Boolean wall by ray casts.
remainingRisks: Runtime revision is available for local review; no deployment requested.
Full generic skill validator remains incompatible with zero-spend local Blender production.

proposedLessons.observation: 精细二次元室内参考中的构件层次不能由简陋程序草模表达；真实 Blender 多视角渲染揭露开口法线、透光与人物背景问题。
proposedLessons.rule: 用户要求精细参考图建模时，以可编辑的 Blender 几何和真实审阅渲染作为交付证据，草模只作布局中间件。

proposedLessons.observation: Independent timber rows crossed café windows even though the shell Boolean holes were correct.
proposedLessons.rule: Derive wall posts and crossbeams from one actual pier schedule; inspect render and ray-test evaluated support backing before delivery.

runtimeMaterialRevision.method: reusable PBR material textures, per-object UV projection, preserved artwork and vertex colors; runtime lights
runtimeMaterialRevision.windows: MeshPhysicalMaterial rough transmission: actual refraction and blurred scenery, with a rendered sky behind glazing
runtimeMaterialRevision.displayGlass: street clear glass with reflection multiplier 0.35 and highlight cap 0.12
runtimeMaterialRevision.exterior: 3 coherent tree crowns, 6 aligned pitched-roof houses with windows, doors and supporting shore
runtimeMaterialRevision.menu: Chinese menu.png reloaded and repacked in Blender source
runtimeMaterialRevision.reverseWall: oak wainscot, framed Chinese welcome board and two botanical/coastal prints
